name: Hartlaub's Spurfowl
rangeDescription: Rocky hill country of southwestern angola to central namibia
description: Small francolin with an unusually long and downcurved bill. The male and female are very different: the male has a white eye-stripe and heavy streaking below, while the female has plain rufous underparts.

name: Flammulated Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Pacific lowlands of western mexico (sinaloa to western chiapas)
description: Medium-sized flycatcher of thorn forest and brushy woodland in tropical lowlands and foothills of west Mexico. Mostly sluggish and easily overlooked unless singing; tends to stay within cover rather than coming out into open areas.

name: American Golden-Plover
rangeDescription: Breeds alaska and northern canada; winters in southern south america, primarily in eastern argentina and adjacent paraguay and southern brazil
description: Slender, long-winged plover usually found in relatively dry habitats. Breeding plumage shows black belly and face, white neck sides, and dark back and crown spangled with gold.

name: African Penguin
rangeDescription: Coasts and islands off namibia, south africa, and adjacent waters
description: The only penguin regularly found within its range. A pudgy, flightless, black-and-white seabird with wings modified into flippers.

name: Black-lored Cisticola
rangeDescription: Highlands of northern malawi, northeastern zambia, and southern tanzania
description: Large, relatively colorful montane cisticola. Note the rufous cap and back of the neck, black patch between the bill and the eye, and the pale and black bands at the tip of the tail.

name: Costa Rican Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Highlands of southwestern costa rica and western panama (chiriquí)
description: Medium-sized sparrowlike bird with green back, gray eyebrow, black cheek, and white throat. Most similar to Black-striped Sparrow but with entire cheek black (not just eyeline); also compare with Chestnut-capped Brushfinch but note lack of rufous crown.

name: Scarlet-and-white Tanager
rangeDescription: Pacific slope of andes of colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Scarce tanager found only in wet lowland and foothill rainforest in northwestern Ecuador and western Colombia. Fabulous male is unlike any other South American bird: he has glowing red plumage with white sides and slightly darker wings.

name: Isabelline Bush-hen
rangeDescription: Lowlands of sulawesi
description: A large, long-legged rail with rich chestnut underparts, duller brown upperparts, a greenish bill, and greenish-yellow legs. Typically encountered in pairs or small groups within dense, rank grassland or thick scrub, in the lowlands and lower hills on Sulawesi.

name: Sooty Grassquit
rangeDescription: Colombia to venezuela, guyana, and eastern and southwestern brazil
description: Small nondescript finchlike bird found at humid forest edges and in shrubby and grassy areas. Males are sooty black with a gray bill.

name: Sunda Teal
rangeDescription: Java and sulawesi to eastern lesser sundas (timor and wetar)
description: Small, dull, brown duck with ruby-red eyes. Also note rounded forehead with noticeable bulge and bright green-and-white wing patches.

name: Shelley's Rufous Sparrow
rangeDescription: Southeastern south sudan, southern and eastern ethiopia, northwestern somalia, northern uganda, and far western kenya
description: A typical sparrow with a striped back, a gray crown and nape, and a black bib. The rufous rump is conspicuous in flight.

name: Bougainville Hooded Whistler
rangeDescription: Montane forest of bougainville (northwestern solomon islands)
description: A distinctive whistler of dark, dingy appearance. Golden-olive above and bright yellow below, with a black hood and chest.

name: White-browed Nuthatch
rangeDescription: Montane forest of southwestern myanmar (mount victoria)
description: This exquisite nuthatch can only be found in a tiny portion of Myanmar’s southern Chin Hills. The gray-white-and-rust color scheme of this species is unmistakable.

name: Eye-ringed Thistletail
rangeDescription: Andes of central peru (junín)
description: Well-named bird found only in a small area of the eastern Andes in central Peru. Like other thistletails, it is gray and brown with a long, wispy tail and an orange chin.

name: Seram Bush Warbler
rangeDescription: Seram island (southern moluccas)
description: A sparrow-sized dark warbler with an often scruffy-looking, graduated tail. Has dark chestnut-brown upperparts, a whitish eyebrow, a distinct white throat, and dull grayish underparts.

name: Wrenthrush
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest of costa rica and western panama
description: A strange little understory bird, unmistakable if seen well. Plump and very short-tailed, like a small antpitta or wren.

name: Blyth's Kingfisher
rangeDescription: Sikkim to southwestern china, myanmar, northern laos, northern vietnam, and hainan
description: Medium-sized kingfisher of shaded mountain streams in mature hill forest. Like a larger version of Common Kingfisher, but much darker and with no orange behind the ear.

name: Blue-whiskered Tanager
rangeDescription: Pacific lowlands of western colombia and northwestern ecuador
description: Rare tanager restricted to lowland and foothill rainforest in northwestern Ecuador and western Colombia. Brilliant emerald-green with black face and throat marked with short blue stripes.

name: White-bellied Minivet
rangeDescription: Peninsular india (punjab and rajasthan to bihar and mysore)
description: A beautiful minivet inhabiting open, dry scrub and savanna with scattered acacia (Prosopis) growth. The male has a glossy black upper body, face, and neck.

name: Mangrove Cuckoo
rangeDescription: Locally from southern florida to coastal northern brazil
description: Slender, long-tailed bird found in shrubby woodland (especially mangroves). Brown above and buffy below with gray cap, black mask, and bold black-and-white pattern on underside of tail.
